verdict.rationale: The evidence documents programmatic access through the Data API, the Admin API and an official MCP server. None of it describes issuing scoped or least-privilege credentials for an agent: there is nothing on read-only scopes, per-property restrictions, service-account roles or token scoping. The Admin API's ability to manage Measurement Protocol secret keys concerns event-ingestion secrets, an adjacent feature that does not show least-privilege credentials an agent could use.
